recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. The current core source and generated build surface satisfy FHIR-15903; follow-up is only needed if future generation again expands clinical-patient.target beyond Patient or a new patient search parameter explicitly targets a non-Patient resource.
issue_request: FHIR-15903 asked whether the shared clinical-patient/patient search parameter was wrongly scoped to Patient plus Group on resources such as Procedure and Observation, while resource pages showed Patient-only expressions. The Published/Persuasive resolution required patient search parameters to refer only to Patient across resources and subject parameters to cover Patient-or-Group cases where needed.
initial_application: The Jira application comment cites svn revision 14044, now git commit a474a736634709cdfdfdd609f7979e9526607fbf, which added a validation rule requiring patient search parameters to target only Patient unless the underlying patient element is itself Patient-only. Later FHIR-31714 application work added explicit Patient targets to constrained Procedure and Observation patient SearchParameters.
additional_context: FHIR-13601 raised the same Patient-vs-Group target problem and is already represented on the combined branch. Later final issues FHIR-28219, FHIR-31714, and FHIR-32876 refined the same change family by requiring Patient-filtered expressions and Patient-only generated target lists; they are also already represented on the combined branch. Relevant Zulip discussion supports the same patient-versus-subject distinction, and direct Confluence searches found no conflicting seed-specific record.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no source edit is needed. Procedure, Observation, and SearchParameter are active current-build inputs; Procedure-patient and Observation-patient filter subject to Patient and declare target Patient; Procedure-subject and Observation-subject remain broad subject searches; the common clinical-patient block does not assert a Group target; and a source scan found no patient-code SearchParameter with an explicit non-Patient target.
